title: Modding
intro: Learn to edit Kenshi’s records and artwork, build towns in the Forgotten Construction Set, and extend the game with MeitouClient.

articles.description: Find mods on Steam Workshop or Nexus Mods and enable them in the launcher.
See which edit wins when two mods change the same value, and where a patch fits.
Browse community releases for MeitouClient, meet their creators, and learn how to make a code mod.
Check selected code-mod hooks against released, nightly and later source versions, with ownership and failure limits.
Take one feature from an RE_Kenshi mod and find out which records, assets or code it needs on Meitou.
Fit a saddle to the Wandering Trader’s Pack Bull, then hand another player your four-file mod.
Get to know the Forgotten Construction Set’s start screen, record editor, and toolbar.
Look up data management, error messages, and mod files in the game’s FCS manual.
Follow the branches of a conversation and see what a dialogue script can express.
Use faction reputation to store a value that another dialogue line can check.
Build a town in the game editor, then assign its residents and squads.
Pick the Blender plugin that opens Kenshi models in your Blender version, and the import settings that keep faces and materials intact.
Rig an armour mesh in Blender and connect the exported mesh to an item.
Prepare an animation for export and assign it to the races that use it.
